name: limit_edge_flange_not_on_a_border
why: The edge where the bend of the L meets the inner face of the 50 leg (x = 2, y = 0, along Z): on one side there is the wide face, on the other the CYLINDER of the bend — not a planar end face as wide as the thickness. A flange does not attach there; it is refused saying which edge is needed.
_how_it_was_chosen: The first draft took the edge along X at the bottom on the inner face (y = 0, z = 0), believing the side of the L to be a single face. The bench probe (`prova0089 elle`, 26/9/2026) said the opposite: in a sheet-metal part the side is split into segments, and the segment of the 50 leg is exactly as wide as the thickness (96 mm2 = 2 x 48). That edge IS a border edge, and a flange there is legitimate.

message_includes: is not on the border of the sheet
an end face as wide as the thickness
